slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Physio, chiro, clinical Pilates or remedial massage? Mr Turtle had twenty tabs open before he asked. Honestly, it's not a big decision.

Physiotherapy suits injuries, pain and rehab, with an assessment and an exercise plan. Chiropractic care focuses on back, neck and joint problems, with adjustments as one tool among several. Clinical Pilates is supervised, tailored exercise for strength and control. Remedial massage eases tight, tender muscles and works well alongside exercise rather than replacing it.

Many problems respond to more than one approach, and because our team works under one roof, we refer between each other. Send us a quick description and we'll suggest a sensible place to start. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
